ارتشيا (form VIII)
# اِرْتَشَيَا (irtašayā) /ir.ta.ʃa.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِرْتَشَى (irtašā)
# اُرْتُشِيَا (urtušiyā) /ur.tu.ʃi.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِرْتَشَى (irtašā)
# اِرْتَشِيَا (irtašiyā) /ir.ta.ʃi.jaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِرْتَشَى (irtašā)
